name: Sumia
source: Queen Sumia of Hawatia, often called Sumi, is a proud and intelligent leader who embodies the cultural sophistication and resilience of her fiefdom. A skilled practitioner of high arcana and a scholar of philosophy, warfare, and finance, she excels as a ruler and has ambitious plans for her nation.
